newsitem.title: LEBANON: Primakov arrives in Beirut on Mideast tour.
newsitem.headline: Primakov arrives in Beirut on Mideast tour.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov arrived in Beirut on Tuesday on the second leg of a Middle East tour to seek a more active Russian role in the Arab-Israeli peace process.
Primakov was welcomed by Foreign Minister Faris Bouez at Beirut airport. The two headed straight for talks and Primakov is due to meet President Elias Hrawi and Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri later.
Bouez told reporters at the airport that he hoped the Russian role in the peace process would be revived "to rectify the balance and the flaw witnessed lately".

He added: "We think that Russia has an essential role stemming from its knowledge of the region...We think that this role should resume in a manner contributing to finding just solutions in the region."

Primakov, who flew from Damascus, told reporters at the airport that his country backs the implementation of the 1978 Security Council Resolution 425 calling for an immediate and unconditional Israeli withdrawal from south Lebanon.
Primakov will leave Beirut on Wednesday and will visit Egypt, Jordan, Israel and the Palestinian self-ruled areas,

He said on Monday in Damascus at the start of his Middle East tour that Russia, a co-sponsor with the United States of the peace process, sought to be involved more actively in advancing the faltering talks between Israel and the Arabs.
